level_patch.story: One loud neighbour books every vehicle. The score says you are fine. It is not fine.

callout.title: One table, many appetites
callout.body: Your numbers look healthy — utilization is up, average waits are down. Averages are how starvation hides: one neighbour is filling the road while the others never get a turn. Watch the rings on the quiet neighbourhoods.

callout.title: Fairness is a metric, not a mood
callout.body: Good schedulers measure who is waiting, not just how long on average. Put the shares on the wall where a starving neighbourhood is impossible to unsee, and the booth can be judged on it.

callout.title: The community board
callout.body: Per-neighbourhood shares, updated live: who is parked, who is waiting, who has been waiting longest. A fairness rule is now on the menu for the booth — oldest-first across neighbourhoods instead of across the whole road.

callout.title: Round-robin the road
callout.body: Slot the fair card: key by WHO is waiting longest, not what is shortest. Same road, same bays, entirely different week. Watch the board even out while the busy neighbour's ring cools.

callout.title: End of the week
callout.body: You kept every neighbourhood at the table. Take a building — next week someone will want to break an agreement early, and you will have a truck for that.
